records.literal_gloss: And [the] eyes of Zedekiah he blinded, and bound him in bronze fetters to bring him [to] Babylon.

en.L: And he put out the eyes of Zedekiah and bound him in bronze fetters to bring him [to] Babylon.
en.B: Then he put out Zedekiah's eyes and bound him in bronze fetters to take him to Babylon.
en.R: Then he had Zedekiah's eyes put out. He had him bound in bronze chains to be taken to Babylon.

es.L: Y a Sedequías le sacó los ojos, y lo ató con cadenas de bronce para llevarlo [a] Babilonia.
es.B: Luego le sacó los ojos a Sedequías y lo ató con cadenas de bronce para llevarlo a Babilonia.
es.R: Luego mandó sacarle los ojos a Sedequías. Lo hizo atar con cadenas de bronce para llevarlo a Babilonia.

fr.L: Et il creva les yeux de Sédécias et le lia d’une double chaîne de bronze pour l’emmener [à] Babylone.
fr.B: Puis il creva les yeux de Sédécias et le fit lier d’une double chaîne de bronze pour l’emmener à Babylone.
fr.R: Ensuite il a fait crever les yeux de Sédécias. Il l’a fait attacher avec des chaînes de bronze pour l’emmener à Babylone.

sw.L: Naye akayapofua macho ya Sedekia, akamfunga kwa minyororo ya shaba, ili kumpeleka Babeli.
sw.B: Kisha akayapofua macho ya Sedekia, akamfunga kwa pingu za shaba ili kumpeleka Babeli.
sw.R: Kisha akaamuru Sedekia atobolewe macho. Akaamuru afungwe kwa minyororo ya shaba ili apelekwe Babeli.

vi.L: Vua ấy móc mắt Sê-đê-kia và xiềng ông bằng xích đồng để đem ông [về] Ba-by-lôn.
vi.B: Rồi vua ấy móc mắt Sê-đê-kia và xiềng ông bằng xích đồng để giải ông về Ba-by-lôn.
vi.R: Rồi vua ấy cho móc mắt Sê-đê-kia và xiềng ông bằng xích đồng để giải về Ba-by-lôn.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 시드기야의 눈을 멀게 하고, 그를 바빌론으로 끌고 가려고 놋 사슬로 묶었다.
ko.B: 그리고 그는 시드기야의 두 눈을 뽑고, 그를 바빌론으로 끌고 가려고 놋 사슬로 묶었다.
ko.R: 그러고 나서 그는 시드기야의 두 눈을 뽑게 했다. 그리고 그를 바빌론으로 끌고 가려고 놋 사슬로 묶게 했다.

pt.L: E os olhos de Zedequias ele cegou, e o prendeu com correntes de bronze para levá-lo [para a] Babilônia.
pt.B: Depois furou os olhos de Zedequias e o prendeu com correntes de bronze para levá-lo para a Babilônia.
pt.R: Depois mandou furar os olhos de Zedequias. Mandou prendê-lo com correntes de bronze para ser levado para a Babilônia.

am.L: የሴዴቅያስንም ዓይኖች አወጣ፤ ወደ ባቢሎንም ሊወስደው በነሐስ እግር ብረት አሰረው።
am.B: ከዚያም የሴዴቅያስን ዓይኖች አወጣ፤ ወደ ባቢሎንም ሊወስደው በነሐስ እግር ብረት አሰረው።
am.R: ከዚያም የሴዴቅያስ ዓይኖች እንዲወጡ አደረገ። ወደ ባቢሎን እንዲወሰድም በነሐስ ሰንሰለት አሳሰረው።

hi.L: और उसने सिदकिय्याह की आँखें फोड़ दीं, और उसे बाबुल ले जाने के लिए पीतल की बेड़ियों से जकड़ा।
hi.B: फिर उसने सिदकिय्याह की आँखें फोड़ दीं और उसे बाबुल ले जाने के लिए पीतल की बेड़ियों से जकड़ा।
hi.R: फिर उसने सिदकिय्याह की आँखें फुड़वा दीं। उसने उसे पीतल की ज़ंजीरों से बँधवाया, ताकि उसे बाबुल ले जाया जाए।

ru.L: А глаза Седекии он выколол и сковал его медными оковами, чтобы отвести его [в] Вавилон.
ru.B: Потом он выколол Седекии глаза и сковал его медными оковами, чтобы увести в Вавилон.
ru.R: Потом он велел выколоть Седекии глаза. Его заковали в медные цепи, чтобы увести в Вавилон.

ja.L: そして彼はツィドキヤの目をつぶし、彼をバビロンへ連れて行くために、青銅の足かせで彼を縛った。
ja.B: それから、彼はツィドキヤの目をつぶし、バビロンへ連れて行くために、青銅の足かせにつないだ。
ja.R: それから、バビロンの王は、ツィドキヤの両目をつぶさせました。そして、バビロンへ連れて行くために、青銅の鎖でツィドキヤを縛らせました。

uk.L: А Седекії він виколов очі і закував його в мідні кайдани, щоб відвести його [до] Вавилону.
uk.B: Тоді він виколов Седекії очі й закував його в мідні кайдани, щоб відвести до Вавилону.
uk.R: Тоді він звелів виколоти Седекії очі. Він звелів закувати його в мідні кайдани, щоб відвести до Вавилону.

decisions.choice: 2 Kings 25:7: "and brought him to Babylon"
decisions.reason: Kings ends "and brought him to Babylon"; this verse says he bound him "to bring him" there, the purpose rather than the journey. Jeremiah 52:11 adds that Zedekiah was kept in prison until his death. The one who blinds him is the king of Babylon of verse 6.

decisions.choice: the prophets' words come true
decisions.reason: Jeremiah had told Zedekiah that he would see the king of Babylon and be taken to Babylon (32:4-5; 34:3), and Ezekiel had said that the prince would be brought to Babylon "but he will not see it" (Ezekiel 12:13). Both came true.

decisions.choice: bronze fetters: a pair of bronze shackles
decisions.reason: As at 2 Kings 25:7: the word is "bronze" in the dual form, a pair of shackles (Judges 16:21).

decisions.choice: had ... put out; had him bound; chains (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 25:7: Readable says the king "had" these things done, and says "chains" for fetters.

decisions.choice: बाबुल ले जाने के लिए
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 25:7 says "and brought him to Babylon"; this verse says "to bring him", so the Hindi of 2 Kings is kept except for the purpose clause.

decisions.choice: "чтобы отвести / увести его в Вавилон"
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 25:7 in this translation, except that the Hebrew here says "to bring him" where Kings says "and brought him" (m1).

decisions.choice: 2 Kings 25:7b in its Japanese ("目をつぶし", "青銅の足かせ" L, B, "青銅の鎖" R), with lavi' "連れて行くために" for 2 Kings' "and brought him".

source.text: וְאֶת־בֵּ֤ית הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וְאֶת־בֵּ֣ית הָעָ֔ם שָׂרְפ֥וּ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֖ים בָּאֵ֑שׁ וְאֶת־חֹמ֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם נָתָֽצוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] house of the king and [the] house of the people burned the Chaldeans with fire, and [the] walls of Jerusalem they broke down.

en.L: And the Chaldeans burned the house of the king and the house of the people with fire, and they broke down the walls of Jerusalem.
en.B: The Chaldeans burned down the king's palace and the houses of the people, and they tore down the walls of Jerusalem.
en.R: The Babylonians set fire to the royal palace and the people's houses, and they tore down the walls of Jerusalem.

es.L: Y la casa del rey y la casa del pueblo las quemaron los caldeos con fuego, y derribaron los muros de Jerusalén.
es.B: Los caldeos incendiaron el palacio real y las casas del pueblo, y derribaron los muros de Jerusalén.
es.R: Los babilonios prendieron fuego al palacio real y a las casas de la gente, y derribaron los muros de Jerusalén.

fr.L: Et les Chaldéens brûlèrent par le feu la maison du roi et la maison du peuple, et ils abattirent les murailles de Jérusalem.
fr.B: Les Chaldéens incendièrent le palais royal et les maisons du peuple, et ils abattirent les murailles de Jérusalem.
fr.R: Les Babyloniens ont mis le feu au palais royal et aux maisons des gens, et ils ont démoli les murailles de Jérusalem.

sw.L: Nao Wakaldayo wakaiteketeza kwa moto nyumba ya mfalme na nyumba ya watu, wakazibomoa kuta za Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Wakaldayo waliiteketeza kwa moto ikulu ya mfalme na nyumba za watu, wakazibomoa kuta za Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Wababeli walichoma moto jumba la mfalme na nyumba za watu, wakazibomoa kuta za Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Người Canh-đê lấy lửa đốt cung vua và nhà của dân chúng, và phá đổ các tường thành Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Người Canh-đê thiêu rụi cung vua và nhà cửa của dân chúng, và phá đổ các tường thành Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Quân Ba-by-lôn phóng hỏa hoàng cung và nhà cửa của dân chúng, rồi phá đổ các tường thành Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그리고 갈대아 사람들이 왕의 집과 백성의 집을 불로 태우고, 예루살렘의 성벽들을 헐었다.
ko.B: 갈대아 사람들은 왕궁과 백성의 집들을 불살랐고, 예루살렘의 성벽을 헐어 버렸다.
ko.R: 바빌로니아 사람들은 왕궁과 백성의 집들에 불을 질렀다. 그리고 예루살렘의 성벽을 허물어 버렸다.

pt.L: E a casa do rei e a casa do povo os caldeus queimaram com fogo, e os muros de Jerusalém derrubaram.
pt.B: Os caldeus queimaram o palácio do rei e as casas do povo e derrubaram os muros de Jerusalém.
pt.R: Os babilônios puseram fogo no palácio real e nas casas do povo e derrubaram os muros de Jerusalém.

am.L: ከለዳውያንም የንጉሡን ቤትና የሕዝቡን ቤት በእሳት አቃጠሉ፤ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ቅጥሮች አፈረሱ።
am.B: ከለዳውያን የንጉሡን ቤተ መንግሥትና የሕዝቡን ቤቶች አቃጠሉ፤ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ቅጥሮች አፈረሱ።
am.R: ባቢሎናውያን ቤተ መንግሥቱንና የሕዝቡን ቤቶች በእሳት አቃጠሉ፤ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ቅጥሮች አፈረሱ።

hi.L: और कसदियों ने राजा का भवन और लोगों का घर आग से जला दिया, और उन्होंने यरूशलेम की शहरपनाह ढा दी।
hi.B: कसदियों ने राजमहल और लोगों के घर जला दिए, और यरूशलेम की शहरपनाह ढा दी।
hi.R: बाबुलियों ने राजमहल और लोगों के घरों में आग लगा दी, और यरूशलेम की शहरपनाह ढा दी।

ru.L: И дом царя, и дом народа сожгли халдеи огнём, и стены Иерусалима разрушили.
ru.B: Халдеи сожгли царский дворец и дома народа и разрушили стены Иерусалима.
ru.R: Вавилоняне подожгли царский дворец и дома жителей и разрушили стены Иерусалима.

ja.L: カルデア人は、王の家と民の家を火で焼き、エルサレムの城壁を打ちこわした。
ja.B: カルデア人は王宮と民の家々を焼き払い、エルサレムの城壁を取りこわした。
ja.R: バビロン人は、王宮と人々の家に火をつけ、エルサレムの城壁を取りこわしました。

uk.L: А дім царя і дім народу халдеї спалили вогнем, і зруйнували мури Єрусалима.
uk.B: Халдеї спалили царський палац і доми народу, і зруйнували мури Єрусалима.
uk.R: Вавилоняни підпалили царський палац і доми людей, і зруйнували мури Єрусалима.

decisions.choice: the house of the people: the houses of the city's people
decisions.reason: The noun is singular, but it may stand for all the people's houses, as 2 Kings 25:9 says "all the houses of Jerusalem". It may instead name one public building, a hall where the people met.

decisions.choice: 2 Kings 25:9-10 also names the temple
decisions.reason: Kings dates the burning to a month after the city fell, makes Nebuzaradan the one who burned it, and names the house of the LORD first. This verse names only the king's house and the house of the people, and says the Chaldeans did it; the burning of the temple is told in 52:13.

decisions.choice: the walls broken down: the city left without defense
decisions.reason: As at 2 Kings 25:10: without walls a city could not protect itself. They lay in ruins until Nehemiah rebuilt them (Nehemiah 1:3; 2:17).

decisions.choice: the king's palace, the royal palace; the houses of the people; Babylonians (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 25:9. Balanced and Readable take the singular "house of the people" as the people's houses (m1).

decisions.choice: लोगों का घर (L); लोगों के घर (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew singular "the house of the people"; Balanced and Readable say the houses of the people, as the English. Otherwise the wording of 2 Kings 25:9-10, which also names the temple.

decisions.choice: "дома народа" (B); "дома жителей" (R)
decisions.reason: The singular "house of the people" is taken as the people's houses (m1); "царский дворец" as in 2 Kings 25:9.

decisions.choice: The verbs of 2 Kings 25:9-10 ("焼き" / "焼き払い" / "火をつけ"; "打ちこわした" L, "取りこわした" B, R); beit ha'am "民の家" (L), "民の家々" (B), "人々の家" (R); no temple, as the Hebrew here.
decisions.reason: m1 (uncertain; footnoted), m2.

source.text: וְאֵת֩ יֶ֨תֶר הָעָ֜ם הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֣ים בָּעִ֗יר וְאֶת־הַנֹּֽפְלִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָפְל֣וּ עָלָ֔יו וְאֵ֛ת יֶ֥תֶר הָעָ֖ם הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֑ים הֶגְלָ֛ה נְבֽוּזַר־אֲדָ֥ןרַב־טַבָּחִ֖ים בָּבֶֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] rest of the people who remained in the city, and the deserters who had fallen to him, and [the] rest of the people who remained, exiled Nebuzaradan chief of [the] guards [to] Babylon.

en.L: And the rest of the people who were left in the city, and the deserters who had deserted to him, and the rest of the people who were left, Nebuzaradan the chief of the guard carried into exile [to] Babylon.
en.B: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried into exile to Babylon the rest of the people who were left in the city, those who had deserted to him, and the rest of the people who remained.
en.R: Nebuzaradan, the commander of the guard, took the rest of the people away to Babylon as captives. These included the people still left in the city, those who had gone over to his side, and everyone else who remained.

es.L: Y al resto del pueblo que había quedado en la ciudad, y a los desertores que se habían pasado a él, y al resto del pueblo que había quedado, los llevó cautivos [a] Babilonia Nabuzaradán, jefe de la guardia.
es.B: Nabuzaradán, capitán de la guardia, llevó al destierro en Babilonia al resto del pueblo que había quedado en la ciudad, a los que se habían pasado a él y al resto del pueblo que quedaba.
es.R: Nabuzaradán, el comandante de la guardia, se llevó a Babilonia como prisioneros al resto del pueblo. Entre ellos estaban los que todavía quedaban en la ciudad, los que se habían pasado a su lado y todos los demás que quedaban.

fr.L: Et le reste du peuple qui restait dans la ville, et les déserteurs qui étaient passés à lui, et le reste du peuple qui restait, Nebouzaradân, chef des gardes, les déporta [à] Babylone.
fr.B: Nebouzaradân, le commandant de la garde, emmena en exil à Babylone le reste du peuple qui était resté dans la ville, ceux qui étaient passés de son côté, et le reste du peuple qui restait.
fr.R: Nebouzaradân, le chef de la garde, a emmené le reste du peuple à Babylone comme prisonniers. Il y avait parmi eux les gens qui étaient encore dans la ville, ceux qui étaient passés de son côté, et tous les autres qui restaient.

sw.L: Na mabaki ya watu waliobaki mjini, na wale waliokimbilia upande wake, na mabaki ya watu waliobaki, Nebuzaradani mkuu wa walinzi akawahamisha [hata] Babeli.
sw.B: Nebuzaradani kamanda wa walinzi aliwachukua uhamishoni Babeli watu waliobaki mjini, wale waliokuwa wamemkimbilia, na watu wengine wote waliobaki.
sw.R: Nebuzaradani, kamanda wa walinzi, aliwachukua mateka watu wengine wote mpaka Babeli. Hao walikuwa watu waliokuwa wamebaki mjini, wale waliokuwa wamejiunga na upande wake, na wengine wote waliobaki.

vi.L: Phần dân còn sót lại trong thành, những kẻ đầu hàng đã theo về với hắn, và phần dân còn lại, Nê-bu-xa-a-đan, quan chỉ huy vệ binh, bắt đi lưu đày [sang] Ba-by-lôn.
vi.B: Nê-bu-xa-a-đan, quan chỉ huy đội cận vệ, bắt đi lưu đày sang Ba-by-lôn phần dân còn sót lại trong thành, những người đã đầu hàng hắn, và phần dân chúng còn lại.
vi.R: Nê-bu-xa-a-đan, người chỉ huy đội cận vệ, bắt những người còn lại đem sang Ba-by-lôn làm tù binh. Trong số đó có những người còn sót lại trong thành, những người đã chạy sang phe hắn, và mọi người khác.

ko.L: 그리고 성 안에 남아 있던 나머지 백성과 그에게 넘어간 투항자들과 남아 있던 나머지 백성을 경호대장 느부사라단이 바빌론으로 사로잡아 갔다.
ko.B: 경호대장 느부사라단은 성 안에 남아 있던 나머지 백성과 자기에게 투항한 사람들과 그 밖에 남아 있던 백성을 바빌론으로 사로잡아 갔다.
ko.R: 경호대장 느부사라단은 나머지 백성을 바빌론으로 포로로 잡아갔다. 성 안에 아직 남아 있던 사람들과 그의 편으로 넘어간 사람들과 그 밖에 남아 있던 모든 사람이 끌려갔다.

pt.L: E o restante do povo que tinha ficado na cidade, e os desertores que tinham passado para ele, e o restante do povo que tinha ficado, Nebuzaradã, o chefe da guarda, [os] levou para o exílio [na] Babilônia.
pt.B: Nebuzaradã, capitão da guarda, levou para o exílio na Babilônia o restante do povo que tinha ficado na cidade, os que tinham passado para o lado dele e o restante do povo que tinha ficado.
pt.R: Nebuzaradã, o comandante da guarda, levou o restante do povo como prisioneiro para a Babilônia. Entre eles estavam as pessoas que ainda estavam na cidade, as que tinham passado para o lado dele e todas as outras que tinham ficado.

am.L: በከተማዪቱም የቀሩትን የቀረውን ሕዝብ፣ ወደ እርሱም የከዱትን ከዳተኞች፣ የቀሩትንም የቀረውን ሕዝብ የዘበኞቹ አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን ወደ ባቢሎን አፈለሳቸው።
am.B: የዘበኞቹ አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን በከተማዪቱ የቀረውን ሕዝብ፣ ከድተው ወደ እርሱ የገቡትንና የቀረውን ሕዝብ ሁሉ ወደ ባቢሎን ማርኮ ወሰደ።
am.R: የዘበኞቹ አዛዥ ናቡዘረዳን የቀሩትን ሰዎች ማርኮ ወደ ባቢሎን ወሰዳቸው። ከእነርሱም መካከል በከተማዪቱ ገና የቀሩት፣ ወደ እርሱ ወገን የከዱትና የቀሩት ሌሎቹ ሁሉ ነበሩ።

hi.L: और बाक़ी लोगों को जो नगर में बच गए थे, और उन भगोड़ों को जो भागकर उसके पास चले गए थे, और बाक़ी लोगों को जो बच गए थे, अंगरक्षकों का प्रधान नबूज़रदान निर्वासित करके बाबुल ले गया।
hi.B: अंगरक्षकों का प्रधान नबूज़रदान नगर में बचे हुए बाक़ी लोगों को, उसके पास भाग जानेवालों को, और बाक़ी बचे हुए लोगों को निर्वासन में बाबुल ले गया।
hi.R: अंगरक्षकों का सेनापति नबूज़रदान बाक़ी लोगों को बंदी बनाकर बाबुल ले गया। इनमें वे लोग थे जो अब तक नगर में बचे थे, वे जो उसकी ओर चले गए थे, और बाक़ी सब लोग जो रह गए थे।

ru.L: А остаток народа, оставшийся в городе, и перебежчиков, которые перебежали к нему, и остаток народа, оставшийся, переселил Навузардан, начальник телохранителей, [в] Вавилон.
ru.B: Навузардан, начальник стражи, увёл в изгнание в Вавилон остаток народа, оставшийся в городе, тех, кто перешёл на его сторону, и остальной народ, который оставался.
ru.R: Навузардан, командир стражи, угнал остальных людей в плен в Вавилон. Среди них были те, кто ещё оставался в городе, те, кто перешёл на его сторону, и все прочие, кто ещё оставался.

ja.L: そして、都に残されていた残りの民と、彼に投降した投降者たちと、残されていた残りの民を、護衛隊長ネブザルアダンはバビロンへ捕らえ移した。
ja.B: 護衛隊長ネブザルアダンは、都に残っていた残りの民と、彼に投降した者たちと、そのほかの残っていた民を、捕囚としてバビロンへ連れ去った。
ja.R: 王の護衛隊の隊長ネブザルアダンは、残りの人々を捕虜にしてバビロンへ連れて行きました。その中には、まだ都に残っていた人々や、ネブザルアダンの側についた人々、また、そのほかの残っていたすべての人々がいました。

uk.L: А решту народу, що залишилася в місті, і перебіжчиків, які перебігли до нього, і решту народу, що залишилася, Навузарадан, начальник охорони, вигнав [до] Вавилону.
uk.B: Навузарадан, начальник охорони, вигнав до Вавилону решту народу, що залишилася в місті, тих, хто перебіг до нього, і решту людей, які ще лишалися.
uk.R: Навузарадан, командир охорони, забрав решту людей до Вавилону як полонених. Серед них були ті, хто ще лишався в місті, ті, хто перейшов на його бік, і всі інші, хто залишився.

decisions.choice: fell to him: deserted to him
decisions.reason: To "fall to" an enemy is to go over to his side (21:9; 37:13-14; 38:19). "Him" is the king of Babylon, as 2 Kings 25:11 says, or his commander Nebuzaradan.

decisions.choice: Nebuzaradan the chief of the guard: a senior Babylonian officer
decisions.reason: As at 2 Kings 25:8: the title is literally "chief of the slaughterers", the king's bodyguard. Nebuzaradan is the Babylonian name Nabu-zer-iddin.

decisions.choice: 2 Kings 25:11 with small differences
decisions.reason: Kings has "deserted to the king of Babylon" where this verse has "to him", and ends the list with "the rest of the multitude", where this verse repeats "the rest of the people who remained" (Jeremiah 52:15 has a word for craftsmen). This verse adds "to Babylon". The date of Nebuzaradan's coming, given in 2 Kings 25:8, is not here.

decisions.choice: Nebuzaradan ... carried into exile (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 25:11: Literal keeps the Hebrew order, with the groups first and the verb and subject last; Balanced and Readable begin with Nebuzaradan.

decisions.choice: "mkuu wa walinzi" (L); "kamanda wa walinzi" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The wording of 2 Kings 25:8-20 in Swahili for Nebuzaradan's title.

decisions.choice: quan chỉ huy vệ binh (L); quan chỉ huy đội cận vệ (B); người chỉ huy đội cận vệ (R)
decisions.reason: Nebuzaradan's title as 2 Kings 25:8-20 has it in Vietnamese, by level, through these chapters.

decisions.choice: Nebuzaradã, o chefe da guarda (L), capitão da guarda (B), o comandante da guarda (R); os desertores que tinham passado para ele
decisions.reason: The verse keeps the Portuguese of 2 Kings 25:11 at each level where the Hebrew is the same (m3): the officer's name and title, "os desertores que tinham passado para", "levou para o exílio" (L, B), "levou ... como prisioneiro" (R).

decisions.choice: 2 Kings 25:11 copied, with "ወደ እርሱ" (to him) for "to the king of Babylon", "the rest of the people who remained" for "the rest of the multitude", and "ወደ ባቢሎን" added, as the Hebrew here.
decisions.reason: The parallels rule: same wording where the Hebrew is the same, the Hebrew of this verse where it differs.

decisions.choice: अंगरक्षकों का प्रधान (L, B), अंगरक्षकों का सेनापति (R); नबूज़रदान
decisions.reason: As 2 Kings 25:11 in Hindi. This verse has "to him" for 2 Kings' "to the king of Babylon" and names Babylon as the destination, so those words differ.

decisions.choice: "переселил" (L), "увёл в изгнание" (B), "угнал в плен" (R); "начальник телохранителей" (L), "начальник стражи" (B), "командир стражи" (R)
decisions.reason: The exile wording and Nebuzaradan's title as 2 Kings 25:8-11 in this translation, one form per level through chapters 39-41.

decisions.choice: 2 Kings 25:11 in its Japanese (Nevuzar'adan rav-tabbachim "護衛隊長ネブザルアダン", R first "王の護衛隊の隊長"; galah "捕らえ移した" L, "捕囚として連れ去った" B, "捕虜にして連れて行きました" R; hannofelim "投降者たち"), with the Hebrew differences: "彼に"投降した (not the king of Babylon), yeter ha'am hannish'arim "残されていた残りの民" for hehamon, and "バビロンへ".
decisions.reason: m1-m3; the 2 Kings 25 forms.

source.text: וּמִן־הָעָ֣ם הַדַּלִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֵין־לָהֶם֙ מְא֔וּמָה הִשְׁאִ֛יר נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֥ן רַב־טַבָּחִ֖ים בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּתֵּ֥ן לָהֶ֛ם כְּרָמִ֥ים וִֽיגֵבִ֖ים בַּיּ֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: And some of the people the poor who [there was] nothing to them, left Nebuzaradan chief of [the] guards in [the] land of Judah; and he gave to them vineyards and fields on the day the that.

en.L: But some of the poor people, who had nothing, Nebuzaradan the chief of the guard left in the land of Judah; and he gave them vineyards and fields on that day.
en.B: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left in the land of Judah some of the poor people who owned nothing, and at that time he gave them vineyards and fields.
en.R: But Nebuzaradan, the commander of the guard, left behind in the land of Judah some of the poorest people, who owned nothing. At that time he gave them vineyards and fields.

es.L: Pero de los pobres del pueblo, que no tenían nada, dejó Nabuzaradán, jefe de la guardia, [algunos] en la tierra de Judá; y les dio viñas y campos en aquel día.
es.B: Pero Nabuzaradán, capitán de la guardia, dejó en la tierra de Judá a algunos de los pobres del pueblo que no tenían nada, y en ese tiempo les dio viñas y campos.
es.R: Pero Nabuzaradán, el comandante de la guardia, dejó en la tierra de Judá a algunos de los más pobres, que no tenían nada. En ese tiempo les dio viñas y campos.

fr.L: Mais des pauvres du peuple, qui n’avaient rien, Nebouzaradân, chef des gardes, en laissa dans le pays de Juda ; et il leur donna des vignes et des champs en ce jour-là.
fr.B: Mais Nebouzaradân, le commandant de la garde, laissa dans le pays de Juda une partie des pauvres du peuple, qui ne possédaient rien, et il leur donna alors des vignes et des champs.
fr.R: Mais Nebouzaradân, le chef de la garde, a laissé dans le pays de Juda quelques-uns des plus pauvres, qui ne possédaient rien. À ce moment-là, il leur a donné des vignes et des champs.

decisions.choice: 2 Kings 25:12: left as vinedressers and field workers
decisions.reason: Kings says the captain left some of the poorest of the land as vinedressers and field workers. This verse says they owned nothing, that they were left "in the land of Judah", and that he gave them vineyards and fields.

decisions.choice: fields: farmland, a word found only here
decisions.reason: The word appears nowhere else, and its sense comes from its place beside "vineyards" and from the related word for field workers in 2 Kings 25:12. It names land for crops.

decisions.choice: the landless given land
decisions.reason: The people who had owned nothing were left in the land and given the vineyards and fields of those taken away. The exile of the powerful turned the poor into landholders.

decisions.choice: on that day: at that time
decisions.reason: The phrase ties the gift to the time of the exile, not to one particular day.

decisions.choice: at that time (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the idiom (m4); Literal keeps "on that day".

decisions.choice: उसी समय; दाख की बारियाँ (B), अंगूर के बाग़ (R)
decisions.reason: As 2 Kings 25:12 in Hindi for the poor left behind; here they are given vineyards and fields rather than left to work them, so the end of the verse is new. "On that day" is उसी दिन at Literal and उसी समय at Balanced and Readable, as the English.

decisions.choice: "тогда же" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "On that day" means at that time (m4); Literal keeps "в тот день". Where 2 Kings 25:12 says they were left to tend vines and fields, here they are given the land (m1, m3).

decisions.choice: 2 Kings 25:12's "…のうちから…残した" (L) and "一部を残し(ていきました)" (B, R) kept; the rest as the Hebrew differs: "何も持っていない", Nebuzaradan named, "ユダの地に", and the gift of keramim vigevim "ぶどう畑と畑" bayyom hahu' "その日" (L), "そのとき" (B, R).
decisions.reason: m1, m2 (uncertain), m4.

decisions.choice: by the hand of Nebuzaradan: through him, for him to carry out
decisions.reason: "By the hand of" someone means through him as the agent. The king sent the order by Nebuzaradan, who was to see it done.

decisions.choice: commanded: an order given before the officers acted
decisions.reason: The verb simply continues the story, but the king was at Riblah (verse 5), far from Jerusalem, so the order must have been sent earlier, before the officers took Jeremiah out (verses 13-14).

decisions.choice: why the king cared about Jeremiah
decisions.reason: The text gives no reason. The Babylonians may have heard that Jeremiah had urged the city to surrender (21:9; 38:2, 17); those who deserted would have reported it. Chapter 40:2-3 puts in Nebuzaradan's mouth the view that the LORD had brought this disaster on the city because of its sin, as Jeremiah had said.

decisions.choice: not in the Greek
decisions.reason: This verse is part of the section absent from the Greek translation (see verse 4).

decisions.choice: had given orders (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the past perfect to show that the order came before the events of verses 13-14 (m2). Readable makes the order a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: आज्ञा दे रखी थी
decisions.reason: The order was given before the officers acted, as the English "had given orders"; Hindi says it with दे रखी थी.

decisions.choice: "ещё раньше дал повеление / приказ"
decisions.reason: Russian has no past perfect; "ещё раньше" shows that the order was given before the officers acted (m2), as the English past perfect does.

sw.R: "Mchukue Yeremia, umtunze. Usimdhuru kwa njia yoyote. Mfanyie lolote atakalokuomba."

vi.L: "Hãy đem ông ấy đi và để mắt trông nom ông ấy, đừng làm điều gì hại ông ấy; nhưng ông ấy nói với ngươi thế nào, hãy làm cho ông ấy như vậy."
vi.B: "Hãy đem ông ấy đi và chăm sóc ông ấy. Đừng làm hại ông ấy, nhưng hãy làm cho ông ấy bất cứ điều gì ông ấy xin."
vi.R: "Hãy đem Giê-rê-mi đi và chăm sóc ông ấy. Đừng làm hại ông ấy điều gì. Ông ấy xin gì thì hãy làm cho ông ấy điều đó."

ko.L: "그를 데려다가 네 눈을 그에게 두고, 그에게 아무 해도 끼치지 마라. 오히려 그가 너에게 말하는 대로 그에게 해 주어라."
ko.B: "그를 데려다가 잘 돌보아 주어라. 그에게 아무 해도 끼치지 말고, 그가 너에게 부탁하는 대로 다 해 주어라."
ko.R: "예레미야를 데려다가 잘 돌보아 주어라. 그를 조금도 해치지 마라. 그가 해 달라는 것은 무엇이든 해 주어라."

pt.L: "Tome-o e ponha os seus olhos sobre ele, e não lhe faça mal nenhum; mas faça com ele conforme ele lhe disser."
pt.B: "Tome-o e cuide dele. Não lhe faça mal nenhum, mas faça por ele tudo o que ele lhe pedir."
pt.R: "Pegue Jeremias e cuide dele. Não lhe faça mal nenhum. Faça por ele tudo o que ele lhe pedir."

am.L: «ውሰደው፤ ዓይኖችህንም በእርሱ ላይ አድርግ፤ ክፉም ነገር ምንም አታድርግበት፤ ነገር ግን እርሱ እንደሚነግርህ እንዲሁ አድርግለት።»
am.B: «ውሰደው፤ ተንከባከበውም። ምንም ጉዳት አታድርስበት፤ የሚጠይቅህን ሁሉ አድርግለት።»
am.R: «ኤርምያስን ውሰደውና ተንከባከበው። በምንም ዓይነት አትጉዳው። እንድታደርግለት የሚጠይቅህን ሁሉ አድርግለት።»

hi.L: "उसे ले लो, और उस पर अपनी आँखें लगाए रखो, और उसके साथ कुछ बुरा न करो; पर जैसा वह तुमसे कहे, वैसा ही उसके साथ करो।"
hi.B: "उसे ले जाओ और उसकी देखभाल करो। उसे कोई हानि न पहुँचाना, पर जो कुछ वह तुमसे माँगे, उसके लिए वही करना।"
hi.R: "यिर्मयाह को ले जाओ और उसकी देखभाल करो। उसे किसी तरह की चोट मत पहुँचाना। वह तुमसे जो भी करने को कहे, उसके लिए वही करना।"

ru.L: «Возьми его и обрати на него свои глаза, и не делай ему ничего худого; но как он скажет тебе, так и поступи с ним.»
ru.B: «Возьми его и позаботься о нём. Не причиняй ему зла, но делай для него всё, о чём он тебя попросит.»
ru.R: «Возьми Иеремию и позаботься о нём. Ни в чём не обижай его. Делай для него всё, о чём он тебя попросит.»

ja.L: 「彼を連れて行き、彼に目をかけよ。彼に何も悪いことをするな。彼が言うとおりに、彼にしてやれ。」
ja.B: 「彼を引き取って、よく面倒を見よ。彼に危害を加えてはならない。彼が求めることは何でもしてやれ。」
ja.R: 「エレミヤを引き取って、よく世話をしなさい。どんなことでも、彼を傷つけてはいけない。彼が頼むことは、何でもしてやりなさい。」

uk.L: «Візьми його і поклади на нього свої очі, і не зроби йому нічого лихого; але як він скаже тобі, так зроби з ним».
uk.B: «Візьми його й подбай про нього. Не зроби йому нічого лихого, але зроби для нього все, що він тебе попросить».
uk.R: «Візьми Єремію й подбай про нього. Не скривдь його нічим. Зроби для нього все, що він попросить».

decisions.choice: set your eyes on him: watch over him with care
decisions.reason: To set one's eyes on someone is to keep watch over him for his good (40:4; Genesis 44:21). The order is for Jeremiah's protection.

decisions.choice: as he speaks to you, so do with him: let Jeremiah's own wishes decide
decisions.reason: Jeremiah himself is to say what is done with him. In 40:4-5 Nebuzaradan offers him the choice of going to Babylon or staying in the land.

decisions.choice: not in the Greek
decisions.reason: As in verse 4.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable names the man the order is about.

decisions.choice: você (the king to his officer)
decisions.reason: The king of Babylon gives his officer an order with "você", as people speak to each other; "ponha os seus olhos sobre ele" keeps the idiom at Literal (m1).

decisions.choice: "set your eyes on him" is kept as "ዓይኖችህን በእርሱ ላይ አድርግ" at Literal and said as "ተንከባከበው" (look after him) at Balanced and Readable.
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the idiom as care, not watchfulness against him; "ጠብቀው" could sound like keeping him under guard.

decisions.choice: उसकी देखभाल करो
decisions.reason: "Set your eyes on him" means watching over him with care; Literal keeps the image, Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: "обрати на него свои глаза"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the idiom; it means to watch over him with care (m1), which Balanced and Readable say with "позаботься о нём".

decisions.choice: The king's order to his officer plain (〜せよ / 〜するな L, 〜してはならない B, 〜しなさい / 〜してはいけない R), without a pronoun for the officer; 'einekha sim 'alav "目をかけよ" (L), "よく面倒を見よ" (B), "よく世話をしなさい" (R).
decisions.reason: m1, m2; a king's orders as 2 Kings.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֞ח נְבֽוּזַרְאֲדָ֣ן רַב־טַבָּחִ֗ים וּנְבֽוּשַׁזְבָּן֙רַב־סָרִ֔יס וְנֵרְגַ֥ל שַׂר־אֶ֖צֶר רַב־מָ֑ג וְכֹ֖ל רַבֵּ֥י מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent Nebuzaradan chief of [the] guards, and Nebushazban [the] Rab-saris, and Nergal-sharezer [the] Rab-mag, and all [the] chiefs of [the] king of Babylon,

en.L: And Nebuzaradan the chief of the guard sent, and Nebushazban the Rab-saris, and Nergal-sharezer the Rab-mag, and all the chief officers of the king of Babylon,
en.B: So Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, Nebushazban the chief of the court officials, Nergal-sharezer the Rab-mag and all the king of Babylon's chief officers sent word,
en.R: So Nebuzaradan, the commander of the guard, sent for Jeremiah. With him were Nebushazban, the head of the palace officials, Nergal-sharezer the Rab-mag, and all the other chief officers of the king of Babylon.

es.L: Y envió Nabuzaradán, jefe de la guardia, y Nebusazbán el Rabsaris, y Nergal-sarezer el Rabmag, y todos los jefes del rey de Babilonia,
es.B: Así que Nabuzaradán, capitán de la guardia, Nebusazbán, el jefe de los funcionarios de la corte, Nergal-sarezer el Rabmag y todos los altos oficiales del rey de Babilonia mandaron
es.R: Así que Nabuzaradán, el comandante de la guardia, mandó a buscar a Jeremías. Con él estaban Nebusazbán, el jefe de los funcionarios del palacio, Nergal-sarezer el Rabmag y todos los demás altos oficiales del rey de Babilonia.

fr.L: Et Nebouzaradân, chef des gardes, envoya, ainsi que Nebouzazbân le Rab-Saris, et Nergal-Sharetser le Rab-Mag, et tous les grands du roi de Babylone,
fr.B: Nebouzaradân, le commandant de la garde, Nebouzazbân le chef des hauts fonctionnaires, Nergal-Sharetser le Rab-Mag et tous les grands officiers du roi de Babylone envoyèrent donc
fr.R: Nebouzaradân, le chef de la garde, a donc envoyé chercher Jérémie. Avec lui, il y avait Nebouzazbân, le chef des fonctionnaires du palais, Nergal-Sharetser le Rab-Mag, et tous les autres grands officiers du roi de Babylone.

sw.L: Basi Nebuzaradani mkuu wa walinzi akatuma, na Nebushazbani Rab-sarisi, na Nergal-shareza Rab-magi, na wakuu wote wa mfalme wa Babeli,
sw.B: Basi Nebuzaradani kamanda wa walinzi, Nebushazbani mkuu wa maafisa wa ikulu, Nergal-shareza Rab-magi na maafisa wakuu wote wa mfalme wa Babeli wakatuma ujumbe,
sw.R: Basi Nebuzaradani, kamanda wa walinzi, akatuma watu wamlete Yeremia. Pamoja naye walikuwa Nebushazbani, kiongozi wa maafisa wa ikulu, Nergal-shareza Rab-magi, na maafisa wengine wakuu wote wa mfalme wa Babeli.

vi.L: Vậy Nê-bu-xa-a-đan, quan chỉ huy vệ binh, sai người, cùng Nê-bu-sa-ban là Ráp-sa-ri, Nẹt-ganh-Sa-rết-xe là Ráp-mác, và tất cả các quan chức cao cấp của vua Ba-by-lôn,
vi.B: Vậy Nê-bu-xa-a-đan, quan chỉ huy đội cận vệ, Nê-bu-sa-ban, trưởng các quan trong triều, Nẹt-ganh-Sa-rết-xe là Ráp-mác, và tất cả các quan chức cao cấp của vua Ba-by-lôn sai người
vi.R: Vậy Nê-bu-xa-a-đan, người chỉ huy đội cận vệ, cho gọi Giê-rê-mi. Cùng với ông có Nê-bu-sa-ban, người đứng đầu các quan chức hoàng cung, Nẹt-ganh-Sa-rết-xe là Ráp-mác, và tất cả các quan chức cao cấp khác của vua Ba-by-lôn.

ko.L: 그래서 경호대장 느부사라단과 랍사리스 느부사스반과 랍막 네르갈사레셀과 바빌론 왕의 모든 우두머리가 사람을 보내어,
ko.B: 그래서 경호대장 느부사라단과 궁중 관리들의 우두머리인 느부사스반과 랍막인 네르갈사레셀과 바빌론 왕의 모든 고위 관리가 사람을 보냈다.
ko.R: 그래서 경호대장 느부사라단이 사람을 보내어 예레미야를 데려오게 했다. 왕궁 관리들의 우두머리인 느부사스반과 높은 관리인 랍막 네르갈사레셀과 바빌론 왕의 다른 모든 고위 관리도 그와 함께 있었다.

pt.L: E Nebuzaradã, o chefe da guarda, mandou, e Nebusazbã, o Rabe-Sáris, e Nergal-Sarezer, o Rabe-Mague, e todos os chefes do rei da Babilônia,
pt.B: Então Nebuzaradã, capitão da guarda, Nebusazbã, o chefe dos oficiais da corte, Nergal-Sarezer, o Rabe-Mague, e todos os altos oficiais do rei da Babilônia mandaram buscar Jeremias,
pt.R: Então Nebuzaradã, o comandante da guarda, mandou buscar Jeremias. Com ele estavam Nebusazbã, o chefe dos oficiais do palácio, Nergal-Sarezer, o Rabe-Mague, e todos os outros altos oficiais do rei da Babilônia.

am.L: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን፣ ራብሳሪሱም ናቡሻዝባን፣ ራብማጉም ኔርጋልሻሬጼር፣ የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ታላላቆች ሁሉ ላኩ፤
am.B: ስለዚህ የዘበኞቹ አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን፣ የቤተ መንግሥቱ ሹማምንት አለቃ ናቡሻዝባን፣ ራብማጉ ኔርጋልሻሬጼርና የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ታላላቅ ሹማምንት ሁሉ መልእክት ላኩ፤
am.R: ስለዚህ የዘበኞቹ አዛዥ ናቡዘረዳን ኤርምያስን አስጠራው። ከእርሱም ጋር የቤተ መንግሥቱ ሹማምንት ኃላፊ ናቡሻዝባን፣ ራብማጉ ኔርጋልሻሬጼርና ሌሎቹ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ታላላቅ ሹማምንት ሁሉ ነበሩ።

hi.L: और अंगरक्षकों के प्रधान नबूज़रदान ने, और रबसारीस नबूशज़बान ने, और रबमाग नेर्गल-सरेसेर ने, और बाबुल के राजा के सब प्रधानों ने भेजा,
hi.B: इसलिए अंगरक्षकों के प्रधान नबूज़रदान ने, दरबारियों के प्रधान नबूशज़बान ने, रबमाग नेर्गल-सरेसेर ने और बाबुल के राजा के सब प्रधान अधिकारियों ने संदेश भेजा,
hi.R: इसलिए अंगरक्षकों के सेनापति नबूज़रदान ने यिर्मयाह को बुलवा भेजा। उसके साथ महल के अधिकारियों का प्रधान नबूशज़बान, रबमाग नेर्गल-सरेसेर, और बाबुल के राजा के बाक़ी सब प्रधान अधिकारी थे।

ru.L: И послал Навузардан, начальник телохранителей, и Невушазван, рабсарис, и Нергал-Шарецер, рабмаг, и все главные [люди] царя Вавилона,
ru.B: Тогда Навузардан, начальник стражи, Невушазван, начальник придворных, Нергал-Шарецер, рабмаг, и все высшие начальники царя Вавилона послали людей
ru.R: Тогда Навузардан, командир стражи, послал за Иеремией. С ним были Невушазван, начальник дворцовых слуг, Нергал-Шарецер, рабмаг, и все остальные высшие начальники царя Вавилона.

ja.L: そこで、護衛隊長ネブザルアダンと、ラブ・サリスのネブシャズバンと、ラブ・マグのネルガル・サルエツェルと、バビロンの王のすべての重臣たちは、人を遣わし、
ja.B: そこで、護衛隊長ネブザルアダン、宮廷の役人の長ネブシャズバン、ラブ・マグのネルガル・サルエツェル、そしてバビロンの王のすべての重臣たちは、人を遣わして、
ja.R: そこで、護衛隊長ネブザルアダンは、人を遣わしてエレミヤを呼び寄せました。一緒にいたのは、王宮の役人たちの長ネブシャズバン、ラブ・マグのネルガル・サルエツェル、そして、バビロンの王のほかのすべての重臣たちでした。

uk.L: І послав Навузарадан, начальник охорони, і Невушазван, рав-саріс, і Нергал-Шарецер, рав-маг, і всі головні вельможі царя Вавилону,
uk.B: Тож Навузарадан, начальник охорони, Невушазван, начальник придворних урядовців, Нергал-Шарецер, рав-маг, і всі головні вельможі вавилонського царя послали
uk.R: Тож Навузарадан, командир охорони, послав по Єремію. З ним були Невушазван, головний палацовий урядовець, Нергал-Шарецер, рав-маг, і всі інші головні вельможі вавилонського царя.

decisions.choice: Nebushazban the Rab-saris: a chief court official not named in verse 3
decisions.reason: Verse 3 names Sarsekim as the Rab-saris; here the title goes with Nebushazban (Nabu-shezibanni, "Nabu, save me"). Two men may have held the title at different times, or the names in verse 3 are to be divided differently (see verse 3). Nergal-sharezer the Rab-mag is the man named last in verse 3.

decisions.choice: sent: the sentence continues in verse 14
decisions.reason: The verb is singular, agreeing with Nebuzaradan, who is named first and acts for the rest. What they sent to do follows in verse 14, which repeats "they sent".

decisions.choice: the chief officers: the great men of the king's court
decisions.reason: The word is the plural of "chief", the first part of the titles Rab-saris and Rab-mag. It is a different word from the "princes" of verse 3, but it names the same group of high officers.

decisions.choice: not in the Greek
decisions.reason: This verse ends the section absent from the Greek translation (see verse 4).

decisions.choice: sent word (Balanced); sent for Jeremiah (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the verb an object; Readable names Jeremiah and makes the list of officers a second sentence.

decisions.choice: "사람을 보냈다." closes verse 13 at Balanced, and verse 14 begins "그들은"
decisions.reason: Korean ends its sentence with the verb; Balanced makes verse 13 a sentence so each verse keeps its own content. Literal keeps the open sentence with "-어,".

decisions.choice: Nebusazbã; os chefes (L), os altos oficiais (B, R)
decisions.reason: The name (m1) takes the nasal ending Portuguese writes for "-an", as "Nebuzaradã". The rabbim (m3) are a different word from the sarim of verse 3, so Literal says "chefes" and Balanced and Readable "altos oficiais", as the English says "chief officers".

decisions.choice: नबूशज़बान; प्रधान (L), प्रधान अधिकारी (B, R)
decisions.reason: Nebushazban is named only here. The chief officers (rabbim) are kept apart from the princes (हाकिम) of verse 3.

decisions.choice: "Невушазван"
decisions.reason: The traditional Russian Bible form of the name; his title takes the forms of verse 3.

decisions.choice: the court of the guard: a courtyard of the palace where prisoners were held
decisions.reason: Jeremiah had been kept there under guard (32:2; 37:21) and had stayed there after he was lifted out of the cistern, until the day Jerusalem was captured (38:13, 28).

decisions.choice: Gedaliah son of Ahikam son of Shaphan
decisions.reason: Gedaliah came from a family of royal officials who had stood by Jeremiah: his father Ahikam had protected him (26:24), and his grandfather Shaphan was King Josiah's secretary (2 Kings 22:3). The king of Babylon made Gedaliah governor of those left in Judah (40:5; 2 Kings 25:22).

decisions.choice: to bring him out to the house: to take him home
decisions.reason: "The house" is not named. It may be Gedaliah's house or simply home, away from the prison; either way Jeremiah was set free into Gedaliah's care.

decisions.choice: 40:1-6 tells of Jeremiah's release at Ramah
decisions.reason: Chapter 40 says that Nebuzaradan found Jeremiah bound in chains among the captives at Ramah, freed him there and sent him to Gedaliah. The text does not say how the two accounts fit: Jeremiah may have been freed here, then caught up among the captives, and freed again, or the two passages may tell the same release in different ways.

decisions.choice: the Greek resumes here
decisions.reason: The Greek translation goes on from verse 3 to this verse (see verse 4).

decisions.choice: the people who were left in the land (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says who "the people" were: those not taken into exile (verse 10).

decisions.choice: had Jeremiah brought (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: "Sent and took" means they sent men to fetch him; Balanced and Readable say so with "had ... brought". Balanced has already said "sent word" at the end of verse 13, so it does not repeat "they sent".

decisions.choice: Gedalías hijo de Ahicam, hijo de Safán
decisions.reason: The form published in 2 Kings 25:22.

decisions.choice: Gedalias, filho de Aicam, filho de Safã (L, B); neto de Safã (R)
decisions.reason: The governor (m2) keeps the words 2 Kings 25:22 gives him in Portuguese, with "neto" at Readable, as there.

decisions.choice: the court of the guard is "የዘበኞቹ አደባባይ" (Literal, Balanced), "የዘበኞቹ ግቢ" (Readable).
decisions.reason: The guard (mattarah) is the palace guard, not a prison; "የዘበኞቹ" is the word of Nebuzaradan's title. Chapters 32-38 should use the same words.

decisions.choice: पहरे का आँगन; शापान के पुत्र अहीकाम के पुत्र गदल्याह
decisions.reason: The court of the guard is पहरे का आँगन, as Nehemiah 3:25. Gedaliah, Ahikam and Shaphan keep the forms of 2 Kings 22 and 25.

decisions.choice: "двор стражи"
decisions.reason: The courtyard of the palace where prisoners were kept under guard (m1); "двор стражи" says so plainly at every level.

decisions.choice: "Годолия, сын Ахикама, сына Шафана"
decisions.reason: The forms of 2 Kings 22:12 and 25:22 in this translation, kept through chapters 40-43.

ru.R: Ещё тогда, когда Иеремия был заперт во дворе стражи, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} дал ему такое слово:

ja.L: エレミヤが監視の庭に閉じ込められていたとき、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉がエレミヤに臨んで、こう言っていた。
ja.B: エレミヤが監視の庭に拘留されていたとき、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉がエレミヤに臨んでいた。
ja.R: エレミヤがまだ監視の庭に閉じ込められていたとき、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はエレミヤに次のようなお告げを与えておられました。

uk.L: А до Єремії було слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, коли він був замкнений на подвірʼї варти, кажучи:
uk.B: Слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} було до Єремії, коли його ще тримали на подвірʼї варти:
uk.R: Коли Єремія ще був замкнений на подвірʼї варти, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дав йому таке послання:

decisions.choice: had come: a word given earlier, while Jeremiah was still a prisoner
decisions.reason: Putting "to Jeremiah" first marks a step back in time. The word came after Ebed-melech had rescued him from the cistern (38:7-13), while he was still held in the court of the guard (38:28), before the city fell.

decisions.choice: shut up: kept confined, under guard
decisions.reason: The same word is used of Jeremiah in 33:1 and 36:5. He could not leave the court of the guard.

decisions.choice: had come; had given (past perfect at every level)
decisions.reason: The past perfect shows that this word came before the events just told (m1). The rest follows the settled wording of "the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD".

decisions.choice: había venido, había dado (pluperfect)
decisions.reason: This message came before the city fell (38:28), so every level uses the pluperfect, as the English the past perfect.

decisions.choice: "lilikuwa limemjia", "alikuwa amempa" (past perfect)
decisions.reason: The word came earlier, while Jeremiah was still a prisoner; Swahili marks it with the past perfect, as the English does.

decisions.choice: đã đến (L, B); đã ban (R)
decisions.reason: The word came earlier, while Jeremiah was still a prisoner; Vietnamese marks the earlier time with "đã" at every level, as the English uses "had".

decisions.choice: "-었었다" (임했었다, 주셨었다) for the earlier word
decisions.reason: Korean marks that this word came before the events just told, as the English uses the past perfect.

decisions.choice: tinha vindo (L, B); tinha lhe dado (R)
decisions.reason: The pluperfect shows that the word came before the events just told (m1), as the English says "had come"; the rest keeps the formula 1:4 sets for the book.

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन ... पहुँचा था (L, B); ... ने उसे यह संदेश दिया था (R)
decisions.reason: The prophets note's formula for "the word of the LORD came to X", in the past perfect here because the word came earlier, while Jeremiah was a prisoner. प्रभु stands for both YHWH and Adonai in Hindi; where the Hebrew has the name, प्रभु is inside a divine_name span whose alternative is याहवे, so the setting tells them apart (recorded once for this block, Jeremiah 39-48).

decisions.choice: "было слово ГОСПОДА к X" (L); "ГОСПОДЬ обратился к X" (B); "ГОСПОДЬ дал X такое слово" (R); "ещё раньше / ещё тогда, когда" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The formula in the Prophets note's wording for each level. Russian has no past perfect, so Balanced and Readable show with "ещё ... когда" that this word came before the events just told (m1).

decisions.choice: hayah "臨んで、こう言っていた / 臨んでいた / 与えておられました": the word came earlier, while Jeremiah was still held, as the English past perfect.
decisions.reason: m1; 'atsur "閉じ込められて" (L, R), "拘留されて" (B) as 33:1.

records.literal_gloss: Go, and you will say to Ebed-melech the Cushite, saying, Thus says Yahweh of hosts, God of Israel: Here I [am] bringing my words to the city the this for harm and not for good, and they will be before you on the day the that.

en.L: "Go and say to Ebed-melech the Cushite: 'Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, the God of Israel: Look, I am bringing {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words against this city for disaster and not for good, and they will happen before you on that day.
en.B: "Go and tell Ebed-melech the Cushite, '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, says this: Look, I am about to carry out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words against this city, for disaster and not for good. On that day you will see them come true.
en.R: "Go and tell Ebed-melech, the man from Cush, 'This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, says: I am going to do to this city what I said I would do. I will bring disaster on it, not good. On that day you will see it happen.

es.L: «Ve y di a Ebed-melec el cusita: “Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, el Dios de Israel: He aquí que yo traigo {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras sobre esta ciudad para mal y no para bien, y sucederán delante de ti en aquel día.
es.B: «Ve y dile a Ebed-melec el cusita: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel, dice esto: Mira, voy a cumplir {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras contra esta ciudad, para mal y no para bien. Aquel día las verás cumplirse.
es.R: «Ve y dile a Ebed-melec, el de Cus: “Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel: Voy a hacerle a esta ciudad lo que dije que haría. Traeré sobre ella desgracia y no bien. Ese día lo verás suceder.

fr.L: « Va et dis à Ébed-Mélek le Koushite : “Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël : Voici, je fais venir {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles sur cette ville pour le malheur et non pour le bien, et elles s’accompliront devant toi en ce jour-là.
fr.B: « Va dire à Ébed-Mélek le Koushite : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël, dit ceci : Voici que je vais accomplir {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles contre cette ville, pour le malheur et non pour le bien. Ce jour-là, tu les verras s’accomplir.
fr.R: « Va dire à Ébed-Mélek, l’homme de Koush : “Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël : Je vais faire à cette ville ce que j’ai dit que je ferais. Je vais faire venir sur elle le malheur et non le bien. Ce jour-là, tu le verras arriver.

sw.L: "Nenda ukamwambie Ebed-meleki Mkushi, '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi, Mungu wa Israeli: Tazama, ninayaleta maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} juu ya mji huu kwa mabaya wala si kwa mema, nayo yatatukia mbele yako siku ile.
sw.B: "Nenda ukamwambie Ebed-meleki Mkushi, 'Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, asemavyo: Tazama, ninakaribia kuyatimiza maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} juu ya mji huu, kwa maafa wala si kwa mema. Siku hiyo utayaona yakitimia.
sw.R: "Nenda ukamwambie Ebed-meleki, yule mtu kutoka Kushi, 'Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, analosema: Nitaufanyia mji huu yale niliyosema nitafanya. Nitaleta maafa juu yake, wala si mema. Siku hiyo utaona yakitokea.

vi.L: "Hãy đi nói với Ê-bết-Mê-léc người Cút rằng: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán thế này: Này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho các lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} phán nghịch cùng thành này được ứng nghiệm, để giáng tai họa chứ không phải phước lành, và trong ngày ấy chúng sẽ xảy ra trước mắt ngươi.
vi.B: "Hãy đi nói với Ê-bết-Mê-léc người Cút: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán như vầy: Này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp thực hiện các lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán nghịch cùng thành này, để giáng tai họa chứ không phải điều lành. Trong ngày ấy con sẽ thấy các lời ấy ứng nghiệm.
vi.R: "Hãy đi nói với Ê-bết-Mê-léc, người nước Cút: 'Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán: {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho thành này đúng như điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán. Ta sẽ giáng tai họa trên nó, chứ không phải điều lành. Trong ngày ấy con sẽ thấy điều đó xảy ra.

ko.L: "가서 구스 사람 에벳멜렉에게 말하여라. '만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 이스라엘의 하나님께서 이와 같이 말씀하십니다. 보라, 내가 이 성에 내 말을 이루어 재앙을 내리고 복을 내리지 않겠다. 그날에 그 일이 네 앞에서 일어날 것이다.
ko.B: "가서 구스 사람 에벳멜렉에게 말하여라. '만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 이스라엘의 하나님께서 이렇게 말씀하십니다. 보라, 내가 이 성에 대하여 한 말을 이루겠다. 복이 아니라 재앙을 내리겠다. 그날에 너는 그 일이 이루어지는 것을 보게 될 것이다.
ko.R: "가서 구스 출신 에벳멜렉에게 말하여라. '하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 이스라엘의 하나님께서 하시는 말씀입니다. 나는 이 성에 내가 말한 대로 하겠다. 좋은 일이 아니라 재앙을 내리겠다. 그때에 너는 그 일이 일어나는 것을 보게 될 것이다.

pt.L: "Vai e dize a Ebede-Meleque, o cuxita: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel: Eis que trago as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras contra esta cidade para o mal e não para o bem, e elas acontecerão diante de ti naquele dia.
pt.B: "Vai e dize a Ebede-Meleque, o cuxita: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel: Estou para cumprir as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras contra esta cidade, para a desgraça e não para o bem. Naquele dia tu verás que elas se cumprem.
pt.R: "Vai e dize a Ebede-Meleque, o homem de Cuxe: 'É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel, diz: Vou fazer com esta cidade o que eu disse que ia fazer. Vou trazer desgraça sobre ela, e não o bem. Naquele dia tu vais ver isso acontecer.

am.L: «ሂድ፤ ኩሻዊውንም አቤሜሌክን እንዲህ ብለህ ንገረው፦ “የእስራኤል አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት እንዲህ ይላል፦ እነሆ፣ እኔ ቃሎቼን በዚህች ከተማ ላይ ለክፉ እንጂ ለመልካም አይደለም አመጣለሁ፤ በዚያም ቀን በፊትህ ይፈጸማሉ።
am.B: «ሂድና ኩሻዊውን አቤሜሌክን እንዲህ በለው፦ “የእስራኤል አምላክ፣ የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ በዚህች ከተማ ላይ የተናገርኩትን ቃል ለመልካም ሳይሆን ለጥፋት ልፈጽም ነው። በዚያ ቀን ሲፈጸም ታያለህ።
am.R: «ሂድና ከኩሽ ለመጣው ሰው ለአቤሜሌክ እንዲህ ብለህ ንገረው፦ “የእስራኤል አምላክ፣ የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ በዚህች ከተማ ላይ አደርጋለሁ ያልኩትን አደርጋለሁ። መልካም ሳይሆን ጥፋት አመጣባታለሁ። በዚያ ቀን ሲሆን ታያለህ።

hi.L: "जाकर कूशी एबेद-मेलेक से कहो, 'सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के परमेश्वर यों कहते हैं: देखो, मैं अपने वचन इस नगर पर भलाई के लिए नहीं, विपत्ति के लिए लाने पर हूँ, और वे उस दिन तुम्हारे सामने पूरे होंगे।
hi.B: "जाकर कूशी एबेद-मेलेक से कहो, 'सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के परमेश्वर यह कहते हैं: देखो, मैं इस नगर के विरुद्ध अपने वचन पूरे करने पर हूँ, भलाई के लिए नहीं, विपत्ति के लिए। उस दिन तुम उन्हें अपनी आँखों के सामने पूरा होते देखोगे।
hi.R: "जाकर कूश देश के आदमी एबेद-मेलेक से कहो, 'सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के परमेश्वर यह कहते हैं: मैंने इस नगर के विषय में जो कहा था, वही मैं करने जा रहा हूँ। मैं उस पर भलाई नहीं, विपत्ति लाऊँगा। उस दिन तुम यह सब होते देखोगे।

ru.L: «Иди и скажи Авдемелеху кушиту так: “Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф, Бог Израиля: Вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} навожу {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} слова на этот город к худу, а не к добру, и они сбудутся перед тобой в тот день.
ru.B: «Пойди и скажи Авдемелеху кушиту: “Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф, Бог Израиля: Вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} исполню {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} слова над этим городом — на беду ему, а не на благо. В тот день ты увидишь, как они сбудутся.
ru.R: «Пойди и скажи Авдемелеху, человеку из Куша: “Вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств, Бог Израиля: {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сделаю с этим городом то, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сказал. Я наведу на него беду, а не добро. В тот день ты увидишь, как это случится.

ja.L: 「行って、クシュ人エベド・メレクに言いなさい。『万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、イスラエルの神はこう言われる。見なさい、わたしはこの町に、幸いのためではなく災いのために、わたしの言葉をもたらす。それらは、その日、あなたの前で起こる。
ja.B: 「行って、クシュ人エベド・メレクに告げなさい。『万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、イスラエルの神はこう言われる。見なさい、わたしは、この町について語ったわたしの言葉を、幸いのためではなく災いのために実現させようとしている。その日、あなたはそれが実現するのを見る。
ja.R: 「クシュの人エベド・メレクのところに行って、伝えなさい。『天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、イスラエルの神はこう言われる。わたしは、この町にすると言ったことを行う。この町に、良いことではなく、災いをもたらす。その日、あなたはそれが起こるのを見る。

uk.L: «Іди і скажи Евед-Мелехові, кушитові: “Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот, Бог Ізраїлю: Ось {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} наводжу {{deity_pronoun:мої|Мої}} слова на це місто на лихо, а не на добро, і вони збудуться перед тобою того дня.
uk.B: «Іди й скажи Евед-Мелехові, кушитові: “Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ, Бог Ізраїлю: Ось {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} виконаю {{deity_pronoun:мої|Мої}} слова проти цього міста, на лихо, а не на добро. Того дня ти побачиш, як вони збудуться.
uk.R: «Іди й скажи Евед-Мелехові, чоловікові з Куша: “Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель, Бог Ізраїлю: Я зроблю з цим містом те, що сказав. Я наведу на нього лихо, а не добро. Того дня ти побачиш, як це станеться.

decisions.choice: Ebed-melech the Cushite: the court official who rescued Jeremiah
decisions.reason: His name means "servant of the king". He came from Cush, the land on the Nile south of Egypt, and served in Zedekiah's palace. He had pleaded with the king for Jeremiah and pulled him up out of the cistern (38:7-13).

decisions.choice: bring my words against this city for disaster and not for good: carry out what I have said
decisions.reason: To "bring" one's words is to make them happen. "For disaster and not for good" is said of the LORD's purpose for the city in 21:10 and 44:27.

decisions.choice: they will be before you: you will see them happen
decisions.reason: "Before you" means in your sight. Ebed-melech would live to see the city fall.

decisions.choice: Thus says the LORD of hosts / of Armies; Look (Literal, Balanced)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for these formulas in Jeremiah. Readable leaves out "Look", since "I am going to" already carries the sense that it is about to happen.

decisions.choice: the man from Cush (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says where he came from instead of using "Cushite".

decisions.choice: "en ce jour-là" (L); "ce jour-là" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for "in that day" in the French prophets.

decisions.choice: ngươi (L); con (B, R), for Ebed-melech
decisions.reason: The LORD's word to one man follows the terms note: "ngươi" at Literal, "con" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah's message to Ebed-melech in 합쇼체 ("말씀하십니다"), God's words to him in 해라체
decisions.reason: As with the Rechabites (35:18): the prophet speaks with respect to the man who saved him; God's own words keep his 해라체.

decisions.choice: tu (God to Ebed-melech)
decisions.reason: God speaks to Ebed-melech, one man, with "tu", as he speaks to one person through the book, and to Jeremiah ("Vai e dize").

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span in the Amharic.
decisions.reason: Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change in Amharic (docs/amharic-style.md section 7).

decisions.choice: YHWH of hosts is "እግዚአብሔር ጸባኦት" at Literal (the Hebrew word kept, meaning "armies") and "የሠራዊት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር" at Balanced and Readable; Ebed-melech the Cushite is "ኩሻዊው አቤሜሌክ".
decisions.reason: The terms list for Kings and the prophets; Readable explains the Cushite as "ከኩሽ የመጣው ሰው", as the English Readable.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Hindi
decisions.reason: The English marks God's pronouns with the deity_pronoun setting. Devanagari has no capital letters, so the Hindi has no such spans; respect for God comes from the honorific third person (वे, उनका). God speaking to a person says तुम. Recorded once for this file.

decisions.choice: सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ... यों कहते हैं (L); ... यह कहते हैं (B, R)
decisions.reason: The formula "Thus says the LORD" as the terms note now sets it: यों कहते हैं at Literal, यह कहते हैं at Balanced and Readable, the wording of 1-2 Kings. The LORD of hosts is सेनाओं के प्रभु at every level, as Romans 9:29.

decisions.choice: कूशी एबेद-मेलेक (L, B); कूश देश का आदमी एबेद-मेलेक (R)
decisions.reason: Ebed-melech ("servant of the king") is kept as a name, एबेद-मेलेक; the Cushite is कूशी, from कूश as Genesis 10 and 1 Chronicles 1 have it.

decisions.choice: "Авдемелех кушит" (L, B); "Авдемелех, человек из Куша" (R)
decisions.reason: The traditional Russian Bible form of the name; "кушит" as in 2 Chronicles 14:9 in this translation, and Readable says where he came from, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Так говорит ГОСПОДЬ Саваоф" (L, B); "Вот что говорит ГОСПОДЬ Воинств" (R)
decisions.reason: The messenger formula and the LORD of hosts in the Prophets note's wording for each level; Balanced keeps "Саваоф" where the English Balanced has "of Armies", as the note sets.

decisions.choice: lera'ah velo' letovah "幸いのためではなく災いのために" (L, B), "良いことではなく、災いを" (R); vehayu lefanekha "あなたの前で起こる" (L), "あなたは…見る" (B, R).

source.text: וְהִצַּלְתִּ֥יךָ בַיּוֹם־הַה֖וּא נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹ֤א תִנָּתֵן֙ בְּיַ֣ד הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֥ה יָג֖וֹר מִפְּנֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: But I will deliver you on the day the that, declaration of Yahweh, and you will not be given into [the] hand of the men whom you [are] afraid of them.

en.L: But I will deliver you on that day, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and you will not be given into the hand of the men whom you fear.
en.B: But I will rescue you on that day, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; you will not be handed over to the men you are afraid of.
en.R: But I will save you on that day, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. You will not be handed over to the men you are afraid of.

es.L: Pero yo te libraré en aquel día, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y no serás entregado en mano de los hombres a quienes temes.
es.B: Pero aquel día yo te rescataré, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; no serás entregado a los hombres que temes.
es.R: Pero ese día yo te salvaré, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. No serás entregado a los hombres a los que tienes miedo.

fr.L: Mais je te délivrerai en ce jour-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et tu ne seras pas livré dans la main des hommes que tu crains.
fr.B: Mais moi, je te délivrerai ce jour-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; tu ne seras pas livré aux hommes dont tu as peur.
fr.R: Mais je te sauverai ce jour-là, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Tu ne seras pas livré aux hommes dont tu as peur.

sw.L: Lakini nitakuokoa siku ile, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wala hutatiwa mkononi mwa watu wale unaowaogopa.
sw.B: Lakini nitakuokoa siku hiyo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; hutakabidhiwa kwa watu wale unaowaogopa.
sw.R: Lakini nitakuokoa siku hiyo, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hutakabidhiwa kwa watu wale unaowaogopa.

vi.L: Nhưng trong ngày ấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giải cứu ngươi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, và ngươi sẽ không bị nộp vào tay những người ngươi sợ.
vi.B: Nhưng trong ngày ấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giải cứu con, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy; con sẽ không bị nộp vào tay những người con sợ.
vi.R: Nhưng trong ngày ấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cứu con, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Con sẽ không bị nộp cho những người con sợ.

ko.L: 그러나 그날에 내가 너를 건져 내겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 너는 네가 두려워하는 사람들의 손에 넘겨지지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 그러나 그날에 내가 너를 구해 내겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 너는 네가 두려워하는 사람들에게 넘겨지지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 그때에 나는 너를 구해 주겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 너는 네가 두려워하는 사람들에게 넘겨지지 않을 것이다.

pt.L: Mas eu te livrarei naquele dia, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, e não serás entregue na mão dos homens de quem tens medo.
pt.B: Mas eu te resgatarei naquele dia, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}; não serás entregue aos homens de quem tens medo.
pt.R: Mas eu vou te proteger naquele dia, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Tu não vais ser entregue aos homens de quem tens medo.

am.L: በዚያ ቀን ግን አድንሃለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ በምትፈራቸውም ሰዎች እጅ አትሰጥም።
am.B: በዚያ ቀን ግን እታደግሃለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ ለምትፈራቸው ሰዎች አልፈህ አትሰጥም።
am.R: በዚያ ቀን ግን አድንሃለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። ለምትፈራቸው ሰዎች አልፈህ አትሰጥም።

hi.L: परंतु उस दिन मैं तुम्हें छुड़ाऊँगा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, और तुम उन मनुष्यों के हाथ में नहीं सौंपे जाओगे जिनसे तुम डरते हो।
hi.B: परंतु उस दिन मैं तुम्हें बचा लूँगा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है; तुम उन लोगों के हाथ नहीं सौंपे जाओगे जिनसे तुम डरते हो।
hi.R: पर उस दिन मैं तुम्हें बचाऊँगा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। तुम उन लोगों के हाथ नहीं सौंपे जाओगे जिनसे तुम डरते हो।

ru.L: Но {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} избавлю тебя в тот день, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — и ты не будешь отдан в руку людей, которых ты боишься.
ru.B: Но {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} спасу тебя в тот день, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, — ты не будешь отдан в руки людей, которых боишься.
ru.R: Но {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} спасу тебя в тот день, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. — Тебя не отдадут людям, которых ты боишься.

ja.L: しかし、その日、わたしはあなたを救い出す――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――。あなたは、あなたが恐れている人々の手に渡されることはない。
ja.B: しかし、その日、わたしはあなたを助け出す、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。あなたは、あなたが恐れている人々の手に渡されることはない。
ja.R: しかし、その日、わたしはあなたを守る、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。あなたは、あなたがこわがっている人々に引き渡されることはない。

uk.L: Але {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} визволю тебе того дня, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, і ти не будеш відданий у руку людей, яких ти боїшся.
uk.B: Але {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} врятую тебе того дня, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}; тебе не віддадуть людям, яких ти боїшся.
uk.R: Але {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} врятую тебе того дня, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Тебе не віддадуть людям, яких ти боїшся.

decisions.choice: the men you fear: the Babylonians, or the leaders of Judah
decisions.reason: The text does not say who they are. They may be the Babylonians who would take the city, or the officials of Judah who had wanted Jeremiah dead (38:4) and whom Ebed-melech had opposed by rescuing him. Either way, the promise is that he will not fall into their power.

decisions.choice: deliver: rescue, snatch away from danger
decisions.reason: The verb is used of pulling someone out of the power of an enemy (1:8, 19; 15:20-21).

decisions.choice: says the LORD (Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for this formula at Readable.

decisions.choice: declara (L), afirma (B), dice (R) el SEÑOR
decisions.reason: The wording set for *neʾum YHWH* at each level.

decisions.choice: livrarei (L), resgatarei (B), vou te proteger (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one of 1:8 and 19 (m2), and each level keeps the word 1:8 gives it, so the promise to Ebed-melech echoes the promise to Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: "declares the LORD" (neʾum YHWH) is "ይላል እግዚአብሔር", placed after the words it closes and set off by a comma, at every level.
decisions.reason: The terms list for Isaiah and Jeremiah: the formula interrupts or ends the speech, so the verb comes before the name, as a tag.

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है (L, B); {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं (R)
decisions.reason: "Declares the LORD" (neum YHWH) in the prophets note's wording for each level, the same in every chapter of this block.

decisions.choice: "— слово ГОСПОДА" (L); "говорит ГОСПОДЬ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The formula ne'um YHWH in the Prophets note's wording, as in Jeremiah 1:8.

decisions.choice: hitsalti "救い出す" (L), "助け出す" (B), "守る" (R).
decisions.reason: JER conventions for hatsil (1:8).

source.text: כִּ֤י מַלֵּט֙ אֲמַלֶּטְךָ֔ וּבַחֶ֖רֶב לֹ֣א תִפֹּ֑ל וְהָיְתָ֨ה לְךָ֤ נַפְשְׁךָ֙ לְשָׁלָ֔ל כִּֽי־בָטַ֥חְתָּ בִּ֖י נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: For surely I will rescue you, and by the sword you will not fall; and will be to you your life for plunder, because you trusted in me, declaration of Yahweh.

en.L: For I will surely rescue you, and you will not fall by the sword; and your life will be yours as plunder, because you have trusted in {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.'"
en.B: I will certainly rescue you; you will not fall by the sword. You will come away with your life as your plunder, because you have trusted in {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.'"
en.R: I will surely save you. You will not be killed in the war. You will escape with your life, because you trusted in {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.'"

es.L: Porque ciertamente te salvaré, y no caerás a espada; y tendrás tu vida por botín, porque confiaste en {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}”».
es.B: Ciertamente te rescataré; no caerás a espada. Escaparás con vida como tu botín, porque confiaste en {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}”».
es.R: Sin duda te salvaré. No morirás en la guerra. Escaparás con vida, porque confiaste en {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}”».

fr.L: Car je te délivrerai sûrement, et tu ne tomberas pas par l’épée ; et ta vie sera pour toi un butin, parce que tu as eu confiance en {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.” »
fr.B: Je te délivrerai certainement ; tu ne tomberas pas par l’épée. Tu emporteras ta vie pour butin, parce que tu as eu confiance en {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.” »
fr.R: Je te sauverai, c’est sûr. Tu ne seras pas tué à la guerre. Tu auras la vie sauve, parce que tu as eu confiance en {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.” »

sw.L: Kwa maana hakika nitakuokoa, wala hutaanguka kwa upanga; nawe utakuwa na nafsi yako kama nyara, kwa sababu umeniamini, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.'"
sw.B: Hakika nitakuokoa; hutaanguka kwa upanga. Utaokoa maisha yako kama nyara yako, kwa sababu umeniamini, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.'"
sw.R: Hakika nitakuokoa. Hutauawa vitani. Utaokoka na maisha yako, kwa sababu uliniamini, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.'"

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chắc chắn sẽ giải cứu ngươi, và ngươi sẽ không ngã dưới lưỡi gươm; mạng sống ngươi sẽ là chiến lợi phẩm của ngươi, vì ngươi đã tin cậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.'"
vi.B: Ta chắc chắn sẽ giải cứu con; con sẽ không ngã dưới lưỡi gươm. Con sẽ giữ được mạng sống mình như chiến lợi phẩm, vì con đã tin cậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.'"
vi.R: Ta chắc chắn sẽ cứu con. Con sẽ không bị giết trong chiến tranh. Con sẽ thoát được mạng sống, vì con đã tin cậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.'"

ko.L: 내가 반드시 너를 구해 내겠다. 너는 칼에 쓰러지지 않을 것이다. 네 목숨이 너에게 전리품이 될 것이다. 네가 나를 신뢰했기 때문이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.'"
ko.B: 내가 반드시 너를 구해 내겠다. 너는 칼에 쓰러지지 않을 것이다. 너는 네 목숨을 전리품처럼 건질 것이다. 네가 나를 신뢰했기 때문이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.'"
ko.R: 나는 반드시 너를 구해 주겠다. 너는 전쟁에서 죽지 않을 것이다. 너는 목숨을 건질 것이다. 네가 나를 믿었기 때문이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.'"

pt.L: Pois certamente te livrarei, e pela espada não cairás; e terás a tua vida como despojo, porque confiaste em {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.'"
pt.B: Eu certamente te resgatarei; não cairás pela espada. Sairás levando a tua vida como despojo, porque confiaste em {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.'"
pt.R: Eu com certeza vou te proteger. Tu não vais ser morto na guerra. Vais escapar com vida, porque confiaste em {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.'"

am.L: ፈጽሜ አድንሃለሁና፤ በሰይፍም አትወድቅም፤ በእኔ ታምነሃልና ነፍስህ ለአንተ እንደ ምርኮ ትሆንልሃለች፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።”»
am.B: በእርግጥ አድንሃለሁ፤ በሰይፍ አትወድቅም። በእኔ ስለ ታመንክ ነፍስህን እንደ ምርኮ ይዘህ ታመልጣለህ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።”»
am.R: በእርግጥ አድንሃለሁ። በጦርነቱ አትገደልም። በእኔ ስለ ታመንክ በሕይወት ታመልጣለህ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።”»

decisions.choice: your life will be yours as plunder: you will escape with your life
decisions.reason: The saying of 21:9 and 38:2, also given to Baruch (45:5). Plunder is what a soldier carries off from battle; Ebed-melech will carry off his own life from the ruin of the city. Here it is a promise of rescue, a reward for his trust.

decisions.choice: because you trusted in me
decisions.reason: The city trusted in lying words and in its temple (7:4, 8); the man who trusted in the LORD is the one who is saved (17:7-8). Ebed-melech's trust showed in what he did: he stood up for the LORD's prophet when others wanted him dead (38:7-13).

decisions.choice: surely rescue: the verb doubled for emphasis
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats the verb, "rescuing I will rescue you", to make the promise certain.

decisions.choice: come away with your life as your plunder (Balanced); escape with your life (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the wording of 21:9. Balanced follows 21:9 but leaves out "only", and Readable leaves out "and that will be all you get", because here the saying is a promise, not a warning. Readable says "killed in the war" for falling by the sword.

decisions.choice: Escaparás con vida como tu botín (B); Escaparás con vida (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of 21:9 and 38:2; here it is a promise, so Balanced and Readable drop "único" and "eso será todo".

decisions.choice: "utakuwa na nafsi yako kama nyara" (L); "Utaokoa maisha yako kama nyara yako" (B); "Utaokoka na maisha yako" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of 38:2 for "his life as plunder"; here it is a promise, so Balanced and Readable drop "only", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Tu emporteras ta vie pour butin" (B)
alternatives: Tu emporteras ta vie pour seul butin
decisions.reason: Where the saying of 21:9 is a promise, Balanced drops "seul", as the English drops "only".

decisions.choice: "네 목숨을 전리품처럼 건질 것이다" (B); "목숨을 건질 것이다" (R), with no "only"
decisions.reason: The 21:9 wording (38:2) at Literal; where it is a promise, Balanced and Readable drop "only", as the English note allows.

decisions.choice: terás a tua vida como despojo (L); sairás levando a tua vida como despojo (B); vais escapar com vida (R)
decisions.reason: The saying of 21:9 and 38:2 (m1) keeps their Portuguese at each level, without "único" at Balanced and without "e não vai levar mais nada" at Readable, because here it is a promise, as the English does. The verb of rescue keeps the word of verse 17 at each level (m3).

decisions.choice: "your life will be yours as plunder" keeps the image as "እንደ ምርኮ" at Literal and Balanced; Readable says "በሕይወት ታመልጣለህ".
decisions.reason: As the meaning decision and the English levels: the plunder a soldier carries off from a battle is here only his life.

decisions.choice: तुम्हारा प्राण लूट के समान (L); अपना प्राण लूट की तरह बचाकर ले जाओगे (B); तुम्हारी जान बच जाएगी (R)
decisions.reason: The image of a life carried off like plunder from a battle: Literal and Balanced keep it, Readable says what it means, as the English.

decisions.choice: "твоя жизнь будет тебе / твоей добычей"
decisions.reason: The saying of 21:9 and 38:2: the life saved is all the spoil a man carries away from the war (m1). Literal and Balanced keep the picture; Readable says what it means, as the English does.
